Tallgrass Energy's crude oil business from Blackstone

The business includes a 75% stake in the Pony Express pipeline, 8.4M barrels of storage capacity across nine crude terminals connected into Pony Express, a 51% holding in the Powder River Gateway system, and the Stanchion Energy crude oil marketing business.

Pony Express is a 1,050-mile, 460K bbl/day crude system connecting oil fields in the Rocky Mountain region to the Cushing, Oklahoma, pipeline hub with direct access to ~500K bbl/day of refining capacity; it is highly contracted throughout the decade with predominantly investment-grade counterparties, the company said.

A successful deal would rank as one of the three largest Canada-to-U.S. M&A deals this year while also providing a test of whether the tariff war between the U.S. and Canada will intrude into the M&A market for energy infratructure.

has a massive presence in the U.S., with a pipeline network that carries oil from Western Canada and U.S. natural gas supplies to utilities, refineries, and liquefied natural gas export terminals across the country; at the time of its $28B purchase of Spectra Energy in 2017, Enbridge became North America's largest energy pipeline and storage company.

The company said it plans to use the net proceeds from the offering to partially fund announced acquisitions and to create financial flexibility to fund potential future growth opportunities.
